t: The Luceco FType Essence flat, fixed, fire-rated LED downlight delivers efficient illumination with a warm white 3000K output. This fully dimmable integrated LED downlight is ideal for domestic installations, particularly in bathrooms and kitchens due to its IP65 rating. Installation is straightforward, featuring a toolless SpeedFit housing connector and loop-in/out piano key terminals suitable for solid or stranded cables. QuickView windows allow for simple verification of secure wiring. The downlight offers a long 25,000-hour life, ensuring lasting performance for various indoor lighting projects. A removable white bezel is also supplied.
